meanings.en: having plenty of space inside
meanings.exampleEn: The car has a roomy trunk that fits all our luggage.
meanings.exampleTr: Arabanın tüm bavullarımızı alan geniş bir bagajı var.

meanings.en: bad-tempered and easily annoyed
meanings.exampleEn: He gets grouchy when he doesn't have his morning coffee.
meanings.exampleTr: Sabah kahvesini içmeyince huysuzlaşır.

meanings.en: kind, friendly, and not easily made angry
meanings.exampleEn: She's a good-natured woman who never complains.
meanings.exampleTr: O, asla şikayet etmeyen iyi huylu bir kadındır.

meanings.tr: boyun atkısı, fular (boyna bağlanan kare kumaş)
meanings.en: a square piece of cloth worn around the neck
meanings.exampleEn: The scout tied a red neckerchief around his neck.
meanings.exampleTr: İzci boynuna kırmızı bir fular bağladı.

meanings.en: having doubts that something is true or useful
meanings.exampleEn: I'm skeptical about the claims made in the advertisement.
meanings.exampleTr: Reklamda öne sürülen iddialara şüpheyle yaklaşıyorum.

meanings.en: the quality of being firm and making a sharp sound when bitten
meanings.exampleEn: I love the crunchiness of freshly baked bread.
meanings.exampleTr: Taze pişmiş ekmeğin çıtırlığına bayılırım.

meanings.en: the quality of having a fine edge or point that cuts easily
meanings.exampleEn: The sharpness of the knife made cutting the vegetables easy.
meanings.exampleTr: Bıçağın keskinliği sebzeleri kesmeyi kolaylaştırdı.

meanings.en: the quality of being clear and easy to see in detail
meanings.exampleEn: The new camera captures images with incredible sharpness.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni kamera inanılmaz bir netlikle görüntü yakalıyor.

meanings.en: the state of being wet and soft in an unpleasant way
meanings.exampleEn: The sogginess of the cereal ruined my breakfast.
meanings.exampleTr: Mısır gevreğinin vıcık vıcık olması kahvaltımı berbat etti.

meanings.en: a song or piece of music sung or played to a loved one, often outdoors at night
meanings.exampleEn: He sang a romantic serenade beneath her window.
meanings.exampleTr: Penceresinin altında romantik bir serenat söyledi.

meanings.en: to sing or play a serenade to someone
meanings.exampleEn: The musicians serenaded the couple during their dinner.
meanings.exampleTr: Müzisyenler akşam yemeği boyunca çifte serenat yaptı.

meanings.en: to sing with a high continuous but changing note, like a bird
meanings.exampleEn: The birds warble sweetly in the early morning.
meanings.exampleTr: Kuşlar sabahın erken saatlerinde tatlı tatlı şakır.

meanings.en: rude, offensive, or bad-taste behaviour or language
meanings.exampleEn: The comedian's routine was full of vulgarity.
meanings.exampleTr: Komedyenin gösterisi bayağılıkla doluydu.

meanings.en: the quality of being cultured, refined, and experienced in the ways of the world
meanings.exampleEn: She dressed with a sophistication that impressed everyone.
meanings.exampleTr: Herkesi etkileyen bir zarafetle giyinmişti.

meanings.en: the quality of being advanced and complex
meanings.exampleEn: The software's level of sophistication surprised the engineers.
meanings.exampleTr: Yazılımın gelişmişlik düzeyi mühendisleri şaşırttı.

meanings.en: easily broken into small pieces or crumbled
meanings.exampleEn: The friable soil crumbled easily between my fingers.
meanings.exampleTr: Kolay ufalanan toprak parmaklarımın arasında kolayca dağıldı.

meanings.en: to make a series of short, sharp sounds
meanings.exampleEn: The dry logs crackle as they burn in the fireplace.
meanings.exampleTr: Kuru odunlar şöminede yanarken çatırdıyor.

meanings.en: a series of short, sharp sounds
meanings.exampleEn: We heard the crackle of the campfire in the quiet night.
meanings.exampleTr: Sessiz gecede kamp ateşinin çıtırtısını duyduk.

meanings.en: clever at getting what you want, especially by deceiving people
meanings.exampleEn: The crafty salesman convinced them to buy the more expensive model.
meanings.exampleTr: Kurnaz satıcı onları daha pahalı modeli almaya ikna etti.

meanings.en: done quickly, without care or interest, just to complete a duty
meanings.exampleEn: He gave the report a perfunctory glance before signing it.
meanings.exampleTr: Raporu imzalamadan önce üstünkörü bir göz attı.

meanings.en: a reduction in something, especially in spending or staff
meanings.exampleEn: The company announced severe cutbacks in its workforce.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket iş gücünde ciddi kesintiler olacağını duyurdu.

meanings.en: the legal responsibility of caring for another person, especially a child
meanings.exampleEn: The court granted her guardianship of the two orphaned children.
meanings.exampleTr: Mahkeme, yetim kalan iki çocuğun vesayetini ona verdi.

meanings.en: using remarks that mean the opposite of what they say in order to mock or hurt
meanings.exampleEn: Her sarcastic comment made everyone uncomfortable.
meanings.exampleTr: Alaycı yorumu herkesi rahatsız etti.

meanings.en: very critical and harsh in judgement
meanings.exampleEn: The critic wrote a scathing review of the new film.
meanings.exampleTr: Eleştirmen yeni film hakkında sert bir eleştiri yazdı.

meanings.en: in a way that shows doubt that something is true or useful
meanings.exampleEn: She looked at him skeptically when he explained his excuse.
meanings.exampleTr: Bahanesini açıklarken ona kuşkuyla baktı.

meanings.en: in a way that shows hope for the future or a positive outcome
meanings.exampleEn: He spoke optimistically about the company's prospects.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirketin geleceği hakkında iyimser bir şekilde konuştu.

meanings.en: the belief that ideals can be achieved, often ignoring practical difficulties
meanings.exampleEn: The young activist's idealism inspired everyone around her.
meanings.exampleTr: Genç aktivistin idealizmi çevresindeki herkese ilham verdi.

meanings.tr: risk alan kişi, riske girmekten çekinmeyen kişi
meanings.en: a person who is willing to do things that involve danger or failure in order to achieve something
meanings.exampleEn: Successful entrepreneurs are often bold risk-takers.
meanings.exampleTr: Başarılı girişimciler genellikle cesur risk alan kişilerdir.

meanings.en: a soft mixture that hardens to form a smooth surface on walls and ceilings
meanings.exampleEn: The workers applied a layer of plaster to the walls.
meanings.exampleTr: İşçiler duvarlara bir kat sıva sürdü.

meanings.en: a small piece of sticky material for covering a small wound
meanings.exampleEn: She put a plaster on the cut on her finger.
meanings.exampleTr: Parmağındaki kesiğe bir yara bandı yapıştırdı.

meanings.en: to cover a wall or surface with plaster
meanings.exampleEn: They plastered the ceiling before painting it.
meanings.exampleTr: Tavanı boyamadan önce sıvadılar.

meanings.en: to waste time or move slowly, delaying without purpose
meanings.exampleEn: Don't dally on the way home; dinner is almost ready.
meanings.exampleTr: Eve gelirken oyalanma; yemek neredeyse hazır.

meanings.en: the state of lacking life, energy, or excitement
meanings.exampleEn: The lifelessness of the empty town depressed the visitors.
meanings.exampleTr: Boş kasabanın cansızlığı ziyaretçileri üzdü.

meanings.en: showing no emotion or amusement, especially when trying not to laugh
meanings.exampleEn: He told the joke completely straight-faced, which made it even funnier.
meanings.exampleTr: Şakayı hiç gülmeden ciddi bir yüzle anlattı, bu da onu daha komik yaptı.

meanings.en: to reduce the value or importance of something
meanings.exampleEn: Constant criticism can devalue an employee's confidence.
meanings.exampleTr: Sürekli eleştiri bir çalışanın özgüvenini değersizleştirebilir.

meanings.en: to reduce the official value of a currency relative to others
meanings.exampleEn: The government decided to devalue the national currency.
meanings.exampleTr: Hükümet ulusal para birimini devalüe etmeye karar verdi.

meanings.en: to make something seem to have less value or worth
meanings.exampleEn: Overusing the award would only cheapen its prestige.
meanings.exampleTr: Ödülü fazla kullanmak yalnızca prestijini düşürür.

meanings.en: to reduce the price of something
meanings.exampleEn: Mass production helped cheapen the cost of the goods.
meanings.exampleTr: Seri üretim malların maliyetini ucuzlatmaya yardımcı oldu.

meanings.en: correct or acceptable behaviour according to social standards
meanings.exampleEn: She always behaved with the utmost propriety in public.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplum içinde her zaman büyük bir edeple davranırdı.

meanings.en: the state of being regarded as proper, correct, and socially acceptable
meanings.exampleEn: The family valued its respectability above all else.
meanings.exampleTr: Aile, saygınlığına her şeyden çok önem verirdi.

meanings.en: behaviour or language that is offensive or morally unacceptable, especially sexually
meanings.exampleEn: He was arrested for public indecency.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplum içinde edepsizlikten tutuklandı.

meanings.en: behaviour that is not honest, proper, or socially acceptable
meanings.exampleEn: The official resigned amid accusations of financial impropriety.
meanings.exampleTr: Yetkili, mali usulsüzlük suçlamaları arasında istifa etti.

meanings.en: to transfer power, responsibility, or duties to a lower level
meanings.exampleEn: The government plans to devolve more powers to local councils.
meanings.exampleTr: Hükümet, yerel meclislere daha fazla yetki devretmeyi planlıyor.

meanings.en: to gradually change into a worse state
meanings.exampleEn: The peaceful protest soon devolved into chaos.
meanings.exampleTr: Barışçıl protesto kısa sürede kaosa dönüştü.

meanings.en: an official order or proclamation issued by a person in authority
meanings.exampleEn: The king issued an edict banning all public gatherings.
meanings.exampleTr: Kral, tüm halka açık toplantıları yasaklayan bir ferman çıkardı.

meanings.en: able to be defeated, overcome, or taken control of
meanings.exampleEn: With enough preparation, even the highest peak is conquerable.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeterli hazırlıkla en yüksek zirve bile fethedilebilir.

meanings.en: to change something so that it is no longer true or accurate
meanings.exampleEn: The newspaper distorted the facts to make a better story.
meanings.exampleTr: Gazete, daha iyi bir haber olsun diye gerçekleri çarpıttı.

meanings.en: to change the shape, sound, or appearance of something so it becomes unclear
meanings.exampleEn: The loud speakers distort the music at high volume.
meanings.exampleTr: Hoparlörler yüksek sesle müziği bozuyor.

meanings.en: to spoil the shape of something, making it deformed
meanings.exampleEn: The heat can misshape plastic containers if they are too close to the stove.
meanings.exampleTr: Isı, ocağa çok yakın olurlarsa plastik kapların şeklini bozabilir.

meanings.en: to become or make something bent or twisted out of shape
meanings.exampleEn: The wooden door had warped in the damp weather.
meanings.exampleTr: Ahşap kapı nemli havada eğrilmişti.

meanings.en: to influence someone so their judgement becomes unnatural or wrong
meanings.exampleEn: Years of isolation had warped his view of the world.
meanings.exampleTr: Yıllar süren yalnızlık dünyaya bakışını çarpıtmıştı.

meanings.en: a part of the body that has an abnormal or deformed shape
meanings.exampleEn: The doctors detected a heart malformation in the newborn.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktorlar yenidoğanda bir kalp şekil bozukluğu tespit etti.

meanings.en: to make something that is frozen return to a normal soft or liquid state
meanings.exampleEn: Leave the meat out to unfreeze before cooking.
meanings.exampleTr: Eti pişirmeden önce çözülmesi için dışarıda bırak.

meanings.en: to remove official controls that have been placed on money, prices, or assets
meanings.exampleEn: The court ordered the bank to unfreeze the company's accounts.
meanings.exampleTr: Mahkeme, bankaya şirketin hesaplarını serbest bırakmasını emretti.

meanings.en: in a clever and skilful way
meanings.exampleEn: She adroitly handled the difficult questions from the audience.
meanings.exampleTr: Seyircilerden gelen zor soruları ustaca yanıtladı.

meanings.tr: çeviklikle, hızlı ve becerikli bir şekilde
meanings.en: in a quick, light, and agile manner
meanings.exampleEn: The cat leapt nimbly onto the narrow ledge.
meanings.exampleTr: Kedi dar çıkıntının üzerine çevik bir şekilde atladı.

meanings.en: a man whose job is to bring goods to people's homes or businesses
meanings.exampleEn: The deliveryman left the package by the front door.
meanings.exampleTr: Teslimatçı paketi ön kapının yanına bıraktı.
